diagnosis.bottleneck: The query executes two full sequential scans of the trips table (for trip_distance>30 and fare_amount>100) and then performs a hash-based deduplication (HASH_GROUP_BY) to implement UNION distinct, which is costly due to large intermediate result sets and lack of indexes on the filtered columns.

hypotheses.claim: UNION forces a deduplicating aggregate over both inputs. (matched: rips where trip_distance > 30 union select pulocationid, payment_type,)

The UNION node (id 1) can be replaced by a single sequential scan with a combined filter (trip_distance > 30 OR fare_amount > 100), eliminating the need for two full table scans and the subsequent hash group by for deduplication, while returning identical rows.
